name: Sequential Gaussian Attribute Decoding
definition: A decoder architecture that estimates 3D Gaussian Splatting attributes (color, opacity, rotation, scale, position offset) sequentially rather than in parallel, using prior attribute information to reduce degrees of freedom and create dependencies between attributes.
summary: Sequential Gaussian Attribute Decoding estimates 3D Gaussian Splatting attributes from tri-plane features by processing them in a fixed order, reducing degrees of freedom and enabling decoder specialization unlike parallel methods.
